name: event_id
description: UUID event identifier — used for deduplication across GA4 and Meta CAPI

name: event_type
description: Event type constant from ANALYTICS_EVENTS (e.g. purchase, checkout_step)

name: event_source
description: Origin of the event: client | server

name: event_time_client
description: Timestamp from the browser at the moment of event capture

name: event_time_server
description: Timestamp from the server when the event was received. Partition field.

name: event_time_processed
description: Timestamp when the event was written to BigQuery

name: user_id
description: MongoDB ObjectId of the authenticated user (null for anonymous)

name: anonymous_id
description: Long-lived anonymous identifier from epicstore_anon cookie

name: session_id
description: Rolling session identifier from epicstore_sid cookie

name: source
description: Attribution source (e.g. google, facebook, email, direct)

name: medium
description: Attribution medium (e.g. cpc, organic, email, social)

name: campaign
description: UTM campaign name

name: confidence_score
description: Attribution confidence score 0.0–1.0 from 4-signal formula

name: confidence_level
description: Bucketed confidence: HIGH (>=0.7) | MEDIUM (>=0.4) | LOW (<0.4)

name: is_reconstructed
description: True if attribution was inferred by referrer reconstruction rules

name: reconstruction_rule
description: Name of the reconstruction rule that matched (when is_reconstructed=true)

name: gclid
description: Google click identifier — present on Google Ads clicks

name: fbclid
description: Facebook click identifier — present on Meta Ads clicks

name: ttclid
description: TikTok click identifier — present on TikTok Ads clicks

name: device
description: Device type parsed from User-Agent: desktop | mobile | tablet

name: browser
description: Browser name parsed from User-Agent

name: properties
description: Event-specific properties as JSON — revenue, item_count, step, etc.

name: schema_version
description: Schema version string for forward-compatibility tracking
